purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are prioritization signals, not measured search volumes and not proof of eligibility, amount, deadlines or agency responsibility. Community and Q&A phrasing is discovery-only; pension housing facts require current Pensionsmyndigheten primary-source verification.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. Scores are qualitative prioritization, not measured search volumes.

demand_signal.basis: Low pension plus housing-cost pressure is a broad high-frequency situation family in the product, and public Q&A repeatedly starts from rent, partner status, ownership or savings rather than the benefit name. This is qualitative discovery, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: Users must distinguish bostadstillägg from other housing benefits, understand which agency applies, find the current age and pension-withdrawal boundary, then move into a four-part official calculation covering basic, housing, income and capital information.

miss_consequence.basis: A wrong age boundary, wrong agency or false automatic exclusion based on home ownership/assets can prevent or delay a person with weak finances from reaching the official calculation or correct support path.

source_fragmentation.basis: Current facts, application instructions, the preliminary calculator, change-reporting guidance and older official PDFs can all appear in search. Older official material can contain superseded age information, so source recency matters even within the same authority.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as bostadstillägg, bostadsbidrag, äldreförsörjningsstöd, premiepension, tillgångar and joint household assessment are easy to conflate, especially for people with lower digital confidence or when using another language.

steps_to_action.basis: A useful product path should ask only age, full public-pension withdrawal and residence before handing detailed housing, household, income and asset data to the official calculator, rather than collecting those sensitive details in the public pilot.

recurrence_signal.basis: The same misunderstandings recur around low pension, expensive rent, ownership, savings, cohabitation and whether a current or older age threshold applies.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The product already listed pension support and had a Pensionsmyndigheten support record, but the public pension scenario asked municipality size, living alone and dental need before the route-changing current age, full-pension and residence facts. Natural-language low-pension/high-rent descriptions also lacked a focused handoff.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Keep one person product. Detect pension plus housing/economy language, hand off only actor/focus/language, replace the old municipality-alone-dental pension sequence with a high-information split, ask age/full public pension/residence only for the housing route, and use the current official calculator for detailed housing/income/assets/household facts. Prefer the current authority page over stale official PDFs and never infer eligibility or amount from a short story.
signals.truth_rule: Community/Q&A language and qualitative scores are discovery signals, never truth. Verify pensioner housing-support conditions and the current age boundary against current Pensionsmyndigheten primary pages before truth-bearing behavior. A stale official PDF, search-result ranking, prior AI answer, ownership label, savings label or partner label must not become an eligibility decision.
